body.summary: appendEvent now returns the index of the row it wrote; both sinks, the two outcome recorders and the user-row write first and post with rowIndex. A load-older handler answers one transcript-page for the active session and ignores stale or malformed requests. session-restored goes through one helper and carries firstIndex 0 and total; the whole transcript is still sent. Re-validated against the amended plan: a followed row is written before it is posted, and after a chat switch the follow stops, posting and writing nothing more, as before this change.
